resources.string: Pact uses accessibility to see which app is on screen, including pop-up and picture-in-picture windows. When a limited app has used its time for today, Pact covers it and stops its playback. Pact does not read passwords or the contents of other apps.
Pact uses notification access to pause background playback (YouTube, Spotify, and similar) when an app is over its limit. It does not read message text.
